name: neo-angband-mod-qol
description: Quality-of-life conveniences for Neo Angband, as a mod
author: neostryder (RPGM Tools)
//private: Not published to npm, and not intended to be. A mod is distributed as a FOLDER the
game fetches - manifest.json plus plugin.js, at a tag, verified against a digest
that ships inside the game. npm is not in that path, and publishing would create a
second way to get this mod that nothing checks.
//dependencies: The engine is a devDependency, never a dependency. plugin.js receives it as
ctx.core at load time; a runtime dependency would mean a second copy of the
engine's module state living inside the mod, which the builder refuses outright.
So it is here for TYPES and for the tests, which boot a real game against the
PUBLISHED engine rather than a workspace build - the version a player runs.
The mod SDK is deliberately NOT here. Its plugin builder is what tools/build.mjs
runs, and that script finds it in a sibling checkout of the game first - the same
checkout the tests already need for the content pack. Depending on the published
SDK as well would pin a version for a tool this repo can already reach.

scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check
